Question: Show order id, order total and customer name for the 20 largest orders.

Write a single read-only SELECT query that answers the question.

SELECT o.order_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_order_amount, c.name
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, c.name
ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC
LIMIT 20

Write a single read-only SELECT query that answers the question.

SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity)
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_id = 100
GROUP BY p.name
